selectRole.title: ¿Ima shina killkakatinata munanki?
selectRole.subtitle: NutriKids-pi ima rurakta kanki, akllay.
selectRole.caregiverDescription: Mama, yaya, wawata kamak: ñuka wawakunapak wiñayta killkankapak, rikunkapak.
selectRole.professionalDescription: Wawa hampi, mikuy hampi, unkuk kamay: wawakunata katinkapak, yuyachikkunata rikunkapak.

login.title: Yaykuy
login.twoFactorDescription: Hampik kuentaka ishkay kutin chaninchinatami mutsun. Kikinpak autenticadora app-pak 6 yupayta killkay.
login.useRecovery: App-man mana yaykuy ushanichu, tikrachina yupayta hapisha
login.invalidCode: Yupayka pantashkami, mana kashpaka ña tukurishkami. Kutin rurapay.
login.setupDescription: Hampik kuentaka autenticadora app-ta (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator shukkunapash) mutsun. QR yupayta rikuchiy, mana kashpaka pakalla yupayta killkay, kipaka app rikuchishka 6 yupayta killkay.
login.qrA11y: NutriKids-ta autenticadora app-man yapachinkapak QR yupay
login.openAuthenticatorError: Kay antawapi autenticadora app-ta mana tarinchikchu. Pakalla yupayta makiwan killkay.

forgotPassword.title: Pakalla shimita tikrachina
forgotPassword.instructions: Kikinpak correota killkay. Pakalla shimita mushukyachinkapak yachachikkunata, yupaytapash kachashunmi.

resetPassword.title: Mushuk pakalla shimi
resetPassword.successMessage: Pakalla shimika allimi mushukyarka. Kunanka mushuk pakalla shimiwan yaykuy ushankimi.
resetPassword.instructions: Correopi chaskishka yupayta, mushuk pakalla shimitapash killkay.

recoveryCodes.title: Tikrachina yupaykunata wakichiy
recoveryCodes.description: Autenticadora app-ta chinkachishpaka, kay yupaykunawan yaykuy ushankiwan. Sapan yupayka shuk kutillami sirvin, manatak kutin rikurinkachu.
recoveryCodes.shareMessage:
